line: Bitcoin drifted lower on macro headwinds while the fear-greed index remains in Greed, and the news is ETF outflows accelerating on Ethereum even as institutions move the asset into custody.
small_line: Written from Bitcoin -2.08% on the day, spot ETF net +2.2M USD (Oct 14, 2026), Fear & Greed 62 (greed), funding +0.0033% per 8h (calm)

wire_top3.line: U.S. inflation accelerated to 3.7% in September, sending Bitcoin below $82,000 as bond yields spiked and rate-hike odds doubled.
Kraken parent Payward agreed to acquire Lithuania's Saldo Bank, securing EU banking license for deposits, lending, and regulated financial services.
Dutch central bank authorized Qivalis as e-money institution under MiCA, enabling euro token settlement infrastructure backed by major European banks.
